place: Lake Norman of Iredell, North Carolina

facts.text: Lake Norman of Iredell is a census‑designated place bordered to the northeast by Mooresville and to the south, across an arm of the lake, by Cornelius in Mecklenburg County.
Across the main channel of the lake, the CDP lies beside Westport in Lincoln County to the southwest and Lake Norman of Catawba in Catawba County to the northwest.
The area that is now Lake Norman of Iredell was first settled by Scotch‑Irish and German immigrants in the mid‑1700s before becoming part of the lake’s modern community.
The Catawba River, which feeds Lake Norman, has served Native Americans and early settlers for centuries, and its name translates to “people of the river.”.
Lake Norman, North Carolina’s largest man‑made lake, was created by a Duke Power Company dam that also supplied hydroelectric power to the surrounding region.
In the mid‑20th century, families from Charlotte packed station wagons to build homes on Lake Norman’s shores, turning the area into a thriving lakeside community.
